integrationReview.reason: Every protected route is validated against a JWT issued by auth-microservice; the role guard rejects requests without a valid role.
integrationReview.contract: JWT identity validation and named internal-service roles enforced by src/auth/jwt-roles.guard.ts
integrationReview.failureMode: Requests without a valid JWT or required role are rejected with 403 and no order mutation occurs.
integrationReview.validation: Role guard unit tests and manual verification of protected route behavior.

integrationReview.reason: The service persists orders, order items, shipments and pricing suggestions in PostgreSQL as its durable system of record.
integrationReview.contract: Relational data model for orders, order items, shipments and pricing suggestions
integrationReview.configuration: db-server-postgres:5432 connection and DB_PASSWORD from Vault secret/prod/orders-microservice
integrationReview.failureMode: Persistence failure surfaces as a storage error and blocks the affected write rather than silently succeeding.
integrationReview.validation: Order/shipment CRUD persistence tests confirm durable state.

integrationReview.reason: No Redis client, dependency, or connection configuration exists anywhere in package.json or src/; the service does not use Redis for caching, queueing or coordination.
The service posts structured logs to logging-microservice via LOGGING_SERVICE_URL in src/logger/logger.service.ts; this is a mandatory ecosystem capability for runtime services.
integrationReview.contract: POST structured log payloads to the shared logging-microservice endpoint
integrationReview.configuration: LOGGING_SERVICE_URL environment variable read in src/logger/logger.service.ts
integrationReview.failureMode: Logging delivery failure degrades operational visibility but does not block order processing.
integrationReview.validation: Structured log emission is exercised by the logger service and reviewed in operational checks.

integrationReview.reason: orders-microservice never calls notifications-microservice directly (no NOTIFICATIONS_SERVICE_URL or HTTP client exists in src/). notifications-microservice is instead a downstream consumer of the orders.order.shipped.v1 event over RabbitMQ, which is reviewed under the event-bus capability.
AI pricing suggestion generation calls ai-microservice over HTTP, confirmed in src/pricing/pricing.service.ts.
integrationReview.contract: HTTP calls to AI_SERVICE_URL for pricing suggestion generation
integrationReview.failureMode: Pricing suggestion generation fails explicitly and does not block order ingestion, status transitions or shipment tracking.

integrationReview.reason: payments-microservice calls PUT /:id/payment-status as an authenticated internal service to bridge terminal payment status onto the order record, confirmed by the internal:payments-microservice:service role in src/orders/orders.controller.ts.
integrationReview.failureMode: Unauthorized payment-status callbacks are rejected and the order retains its last known payment status rather than an unverified update.
integrationReview.validation: Role guard test on the payment-status route and payload validation via PaymentStatusUpdateRequestDto.

integrationReview.reason: Pricing suggestion generation reads product data from and writes approved pricing back to catalog-microservice, confirmed in src/pricing/pricing.service.ts.
integrationReview.contract: HTTP read of product data and write of approved pricing suggestions
integrationReview.failureMode: A missing CATALOG_SERVICE_URL raises an explicit configuration error rather than silently skipping the pricing write.
integrationReview.validation: Catalog pricing write path exercised by the pricing approval workflow.

integrationReview.reason: This service is the orders domain itself, not a consumer of another orders service.
Order creation hands off reservation to warehouse-microservice, confirmed in src/warehouse/warehouse-reservation.client.ts and src/orders/order-fulfillment-handoff.client.ts.
integrationReview.contract: Reservation handoff calls with bearer auth on order creation; warehouse-fulfillment-status updates accepted from warehouse-microservice
integrationReview.failureMode: When reservation handoff fails or is disabled, the order is still created and recorded without warehouse handoff metadata rather than failing order creation.
integrationReview.validation: warehouseHandoff metadata presence check and the warehouse-fulfillment-status role-gated route.

integrationReview.reason: invoices-microservice reads confirmed order detail as an authenticated internal service, confirmed by the internal:invoices-microservice:service role in ORDER_DETAIL_READ_ROLES in src/orders/orders.controller.ts.
integrationReview.contract: Authenticated GET of order detail and lifecycle read models for invoice generation
integrationReview.configuration: Role internal:invoices-microservice:service enforced on GET /:id and /:id/lifecycle
integrationReview.failureMode: Unauthorized invoice reads are rejected with 403; invoice generation fails closed rather than reading stale or unauthorized data.
integrationReview.validation: Role guard test confirms only the invoices-microservice role and equivalent admin/channel roles can read order detail.

integrationReview.reason: No object-storage client, bucket configuration, or file-export logic exists anywhere in src/ or package.json.
The service publishes orders.order.created.v1, orders.order.updated.v1 and orders.order.shipped.v1 to RabbitMQ via amqplib, confirmed in src/orders/order-events.service.ts.
integrationReview.contract: Publish versioned order lifecycle events on the orders.events exchange
integrationReview.configuration: RABBITMQ_URL environment variable read in src/orders/order-events.service.ts
integrationReview.failureMode: A RabbitMQ connection failure is logged and order processing continues; downstream event-driven consumers (warehouse, allegro, aukro, bazos, marketing, notifications) fall behind until connectivity is restored.

integrationReview.reason: The service must remain discoverable by the documentation and adoption indexing stack; this is a mandatory capability for runtime-service profiles.
integrationReview.contract: Direct Git repository ingestion and repository-scoped retrieval
integrationReview.configuration: The project is tracked by the canonical repository registry and docs-RAG index
integrationReview.failureMode: When docs-RAG is unavailable, repository-local intent and operation documents remain the source of truth for the project.
integrationReview.validation: Project documents resolve to the owning repository path and are discoverable without inventing facts.

integrationReview.reason: Runtime health and rollout readiness must be observable; this is a mandatory capability for runtime-service profiles and is confirmed by src/health/health.controller.ts.
integrationReview.contract: GET /health and GET /health/order-events with Kubernetes readiness probes
integrationReview.configuration: Deployment probes and health endpoints defined in k8s/ manifests
integrationReview.failureMode: An unhealthy service is prevented from passing rollout readiness and is reported to the owner.
integrationReview.validation: The monitoring stack confirms health, readiness and RabbitMQ connectivity availability.

integrationReview.reason: The service persists order, item and shipment records as its durable system of record in PostgreSQL, which requires backup coverage; this is a mandatory capability for runtime-service profiles.
integrationReview.contract: PostgreSQL backup and retention policy managed at the database-server level
integrationReview.configuration: Retention and backup schedule managed by database-server for the orders schema
integrationReview.failureMode: Data loss is surfaced and triaged before continued production operation.
integrationReview.validation: Backup posture is defined and reviewed as part of database-server operations.
